messages:
lucy: Heads-up: multiple tiny GPU pods stuck Pending in ap-southeast1 after node image roll. Scheduler logs show reservations present but final bind fails with label mismatch. Anyone?
harper: saw a cluster like that in ap-northeast last week during the small->small-b patch.
diego: can you paste the exact scheduler error?
lucy: snippet:```E0721 11:03:12 scheduler.go: prebind failed pod=gpu-micro-21 err=reservation_bound_but_predicate_failed(reason=NodeSelectorMismatch) node=warmpool-14 reservation=rs-2211```
harper: that reads like reservation created before nodes were relabeled. We rename gpu.class during the node image rollout which would cause this.
diego: autoscaler already added nodes per infra-bot, so capacity exists but predicate mismatch blocks final bind.
infra-bot: Autoscaler: scaled up nodepool ap-se1-warmpool by 1 at 2025-07-21T11:02:40Z (reason: pending pods).
lucy: root cause: reservations stick to old label (`gpu.class=small-x`) while nodes now report `gpu.class=small-x2`. prebind fast-path returns reservation but final predicate rejects.
harper: short-term mitigations: 1) revert prebind fast-path (slower but safe), 2) add temporary alias grace in scheduler so reservation->bind allows mapped labels for e.g. 600s, 3) relax final predicate for reserved pods (risk misplacement).
diego: prefer option 2: add explicit alias map so upgrades don't cause long pending spikes and we keep correctness post-grace.
lucy: plan: canary alias-grace in ap-se1: add `reservationAliasGraceSec=600` + metric `scheduler.reservation_alias_allowed`. If metric spikes or >5% pods placed on non-exact class, revert.
harper: add alert for `scheduler.reservation_alias_allowed` rate and a dashboard showing gpu.class drift per region.
infra-bot: Deploy: scheduler canary ap-se1 started rev=v2025.7.21-canary-3 by lucy at 2025-07-21T11:05:00Z
lucy: logs now show alias events:```I0721 11:05:12 scheduler.go: reservation_alias_allowed pod=gpu-micro-21 res=rs-2211 alias small-x->small-x2```
diego: early numbers: 5/12 Pending -> Running within 45s after canary. Keep canary 20m and push a permanent scheduler patch to support label alias config and a post-upgrade reservation reconciliation job.
lucy: will follow up with PR and runbook update. pinging oncall for awareness. Thanks :thumbsup:
